name: Hats and clap
why: An open hat between the kicks, a clap on beats 2 and 4, and quiet closed hats filling the gaps.

ingredients.name: Offbeat open hat
ingredients.adds: A hat halfway between every pair of kicks, from the default kit.

ingredients.name: The 909
ingredients.adds: The 909 open hat: bright and metallic.

ingredients.name: Choke it
ingredients.adds: Cuts the hat off before the next kick.

knobs.below: A tick you can barely hear.
knobs.above: It rings over the kick and blurs the beat.

knobs.label: clap level
knobs.above: It is louder than the kick.

ingredients.name: Sixteenth hats
ingredients.adds: Closed hats on every sixteenth, every second one louder.
ingredients.listenFor: The beat starts to feel faster though the tempo has not changed.

ingredients.name: Swing
ingredients.adds: Every second sixteenth arrives a little late.
ingredients.listenFor: The hats stop sounding like a machine.

pitfalls: An open hat that rings into the kick makes the whole beat sound soft.
